scope: Broad role supported by this claim's supplied notes, not a person's general occupation. Do not consult outside sources. If several incompatible categories remain plausible, record conflicting evidence rather than force a choice.

categories.name: medical provider
categories.definition: A person or organization providing clinical assessment, treatment or medical care in this claim. Assessing an injury alone need not establish this role.

categories.name: legal
categories.definition: A person or organization acting as legal counsel or providing legal representation in this claim.

categories.name: claimant
categories.definition: The person or organization seeking compensation or benefits in this claim.

categories.name: financier
categories.definition: A person or organization providing financing in connection with this claim.

categories.name: repair shop
categories.definition: A business providing repair services in connection with this claim.

categories.name: witness
categories.definition: A person providing an account as a witness to an event relevant to this claim.

categories.name: other
categories.definition: An explicitly supported claim role outside the listed categories. Explain the role in the rationale.
